system-view.explanation: Enter system view, where you can configure and manage the device.

rsa local-key-pair create.explanation: Generate a local RSA key pair for SSH authentication.

ssh server enable.explanation: Enable the SSH server on the device.

interface [parameter1].explanation: Enter the configuration mode for the LoopBack0 interface.

parameters.name: interface name
parameters.explanation: The name of the interface to configure.

ip address [parameter1] [parameter2].explanation: Configure the IP address and subnet mask for the LoopBack0 interface.

parameters.name: ip address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address to assign to the interface.

parameters.name: subnet mask
parameters.explanation: The subnet mask in prefix length format.

undo shutdown.explanation: Enable the interface (by default, interfaces are shut down).

scp server enable.explanation: Enable the SCP server on the device.

ssh source-ip [parameter1].explanation: Set the source IP address for SSH connections.

parameters.name: source IP
parameters.explanation: The source IP address to use for SSH connections.

local-user [parameter1] password irrever.explanation: Set the password for local user 'client001' with irreversible cipher.

parameters.name: username
parameters.explanation: The username for the local user.

parameters.name: password
parameters.explanation: The password for the local user, encoded with irreversible cipher.

local-user [parameter1] privilege level.explanation: Set the privilege level for local user 'client001' to level 3.

parameters.name: username
parameters.explanation: The username for the local user.

parameters.name: privilege level
parameters.explanation: The privilege level for the user (range: 0-15).

local-user [parameter1] service-type ssh.explanation: Specify that the local user 'client001' can access via SSH.

parameters.name: username
parameters.explanation: The username for the local user.

local-user [parameter1] rsa-key-name [pa.explanation: Assign the RSA key pair 'rsakey001' to local user 'client002'.

parameters.name: username
parameters.explanation: The username for the local user.

parameters.name: rsa key name
parameters.explanation: The name of the RSA key pair to assign to the user.

aaa authentication-scheme [parameter1].explanation: Enter the authentication scheme configuration for 'default'.

parameters.name: scheme name
parameters.explanation: The name of the authentication scheme.

authentication-mode local.explanation: Set the authentication mode to local for the default authentication scheme.

aaa authorization-scheme [parameter1].explanation: Enter the authorization scheme configuration for 'default'.

parameters.name: scheme name
parameters.explanation: The name of the authorization scheme.

authorization-mode local.explanation: Set the authorization mode to local for the default authorization scheme.

user-interface vty [parameter1] [paramet.explanation: Enter the configuration mode for VTY lines 0 through 4.

authentication-mode aaa.explanation: Set the authentication mode for VTY lines to AAA.

protocol inbound ssh.explanation: Allow inbound SSH connections on VTY lines.

return.explanation: Exit the current mode and return to the previous configuration mode or user view.
